positive.text: Under R.I. Const. art. III, § 9, members serve.
See R.I. Const. art. I, § 2 and R.I. Const. art. XIV.

negative: The R.I. constitution was ratified long ago.
R.I. Const. Convention delegates met in 52 sessions.
Article 5 of the R.I. charter, section 3, is short.

note: R23.3: state (and territory) constitutions take the U.S. Constitution form with the jurisdiction's T12 abbreviation; us.state.constitution does not accept this abbreviation.
